name: mealpy-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is MEALPY (MEta-heuristic ALgorithms in PYthon), a Python library of population-based
meta-heuristic optimizers built on one framework: problem definitions and decision-variable types, the `Optimizer`
base class and its `solve()` loop, termination criteria, the run history, hyper-parameter validation, a hyper-parameter
`Tuner` and a `Multitask` runner, plus many optimizer implementations grouped into families.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules: mealpy/__init__.py, mealpy/optimizer.py, mealpy/tuner.py and mealpy/multitask.py; every module in mealpy/utils/ except the mealpy/utils/visualize/ subpackage; and every module in mealpy/evolutionary_based/, mealpy/math_based/ and mealpy/human_based/. Together with them, the pages docs/source/pages/general/introduction.rst, simple_guide.rst, advance_guide.rst, build_new_optimizer.rst, tuner.rst and multitask.rst; every page in docs/source/pages/general/advances/; and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
